source_snapshot.procedure: Enable BIOS debug/error injection, deploy ITP, halt, call ei.injectThreeStrike(socket,port), resume and collect evidence.
source_snapshot.criteria: System crashes/hangs then eventually reboots; BMC catastrophic CPU, front-panel light, recovered UEFI UPI fatal and optional LCD CPU Over Temp evidence.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; delegates injection but relies on post-event SSH/dmesg and truncated SEL evidence.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION; exact target, bounded outage/reboot timing, indicator mapping and recovery remain unapproved.

old_problem: `Reboot eventually` has no maximum wait or boundary between autonomous recovery and operator intervention, while the CPU Over Temp LCD text is unexplained for a Three-Strike/UPI timeout. Tool semantics, target, signatures and recovery are not approved.
disposition_reason: The exact named stimulus and intended catastrophic transition are identifiable, so the case remains conditionally executable rather than intrinsically BLOCKED. ED-16 and ED-18 nevertheless require approved injection semantics, isolation, full crash/hang→reboot timing, recovery boundaries and oracle. These determine PASS and safe action and cannot be converted into ordinary runtime parameters under ED-03.
decision_basis: Directly read XLSX Reliability rows 9 and 10, including exact injection calls, Criteria and DeepSeek fields.
Read GPT V2/historical record 2415 and preserved exact identity and hashes.
A service outage is expected, so SSH availability or a post-recovery grep cannot prove the crash onset, hang interval or autonomous reboot.
The socket/port must map to the intended physical UPI target before the one authorized injection.
CPU Over Temp is not self-evidently the expected LCD translation of Three-Strike/UPI fatal and requires a platform event map.
No BIOS change, injection, reset, power cycle, retry or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: Intel Three-Strike timeout crash/hang and autonomous-reboot validation
test_case.purpose: Inject one approved Three-Strike timeout on each mapped socket/port and verify the complete catastrophic crash/hang, bounded autonomous-reboot and correlated CPU/UPI fatal response across platform evidence planes.
required_package: Intel ITP/CScripts build/hash and authoritative injectThreeStrike semantics
Crash onset, hang interval and maximum autonomous-reboot timing limits
Independent-console recovery, post-health and BIOS restoration procedure
test_case.test_command: On a dedicated SUT after explicit intentional-outage approval, a qualified Intel FAE must snapshot settings/logs, bind the physical target, invoke `ei.injectThreeStrike(socket,port)` once and start an external timeline. Observe crash, hang, power/boot state and indicators without premature intervention through the approved autonomous-recovery window; then follow only the approved recovery boundary, capture complete BMC/recovered UEFI/OS/console evidence and restore all debug settings.
test_case.expected_result: The exact target enters the specified catastrophic crash/hang state, reboots autonomously within the approved interval, records the exact mapped CPU/UPI fatal events and applicable indicators, returns healthy and has all BIOS debug settings restored.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires a synchronized external timeline proving the expected transition and autonomous reboot within signed limits, exact multi-plane signatures/indicator state and complete recovery/restoration. An indefinite hang, premature manual reset/power cycle, unexplained over-temperature message, wrong target, missing evidence or recovery failure is not PASS.
safety_gate: Dedicated idle SUT, stable power, independent console and explicit intentional-crash approval.
Preserve baseline evidence and verify one physical target before one injection.
Do not reset or power-cycle inside the approved autonomous-recovery window.
No automatic retry; escalate on wrong target, thermal/power anomaly, exceeded timeout or unrecoverable boot.
expected_evidence: Harness hash, target map and complete injection transcript
BMC catastrophic, recovered UEFI UPI-fatal and approved OS/console evidence
Front-panel/LCD evidence with documented event mapping
BIOS restoration, post-recovery health and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Wait the full approved autonomous-reboot interval under independent monitoring. If exceeded, preserve evidence and let the qualified owner choose the specified console/reset/power transition; the agent must not initiate it. Restore debug settings and verify health before any separately authorized rerun.
